result.summary:
I built the foundation for this wave, but the five 점검 screens do not have their own top menu item. Right now SUPER's top row of 7 items fills about 629px of roughly 636px available, and that space is the same at 1000px and on an iPad at 834px. A separate "점검" item adds about 77px, so SUPER's row would always run over by about 70px and need sideways scrolling. Shortening labels can't save enough without renaming core menus such as 계약 등록. So SCR-61..65 sit inside the existing "관리자" dropdown, right after 접속 기록 점검 and tagged group:'점검'. SUPER's row stays at 7 items. Every other role that now sees 관리자 (GA, FIN_EXEC, FIN_LEAD, LEGAL, COMPLIANCE, AUDIT, SALES_ADMIN) is at about 517px or less, so it fits at rest and when the bar sticks. If the planner wants a separate top item, the fix is a common.css change that narrows the menu padding when SUPER has 8 items, but the estimated margin is only about 5px.

What was added:
- **컴플라이언스 role (COMPLIANCE):** demo user 반서율 (경영지원유닛), ?role=COMPLIANCE. They also see 거래처 관리 (SCR-55) and 개선 과제와 보류 (SCR-64).
- **감사 열람 role (AUDIT):** a solo, read-only role. Demo user 인채율 (경영지원실) is active until 2027-01-11. 반서율's earlier grant ended on 2026-10-15 and shows as "끝남".
  - Once the end date passes, C.hasRole and C.canView no longer count the role.
  - All action helpers now refuse read-only roles (AUDIT and OBSERVER). They are listed under api.
  - C.adminSave refuses to save for a read-only user and shows a notice.
- **역할 겹침 (C-5):** D.ROLE_CONFLICTS plus C.roleConflicts and C.conflictAccounts. These count roles, 결재선 규칙 assignments and delegations that have not ended. Demo account 방시현 (CEM + FINANCE) has the overlap saved with a reason.
- **사용자 권한 관리:**
  - Only SUPER can grant AUDIT, with a required end date (at most 1 year [가정]) and a reason.
  - Overlapping roles show a warning list and need a separate reason before saving.
  - New optional "요청한 사람" field.
  - The role column shows "감사 열람 YYYY-MM-DD까지" or "끝남", plus a "역할 겹침" badge.
  - 권한 변경 이력 includes the automatic "끝남" rows and the 요청한 사람.
- **열람 제한 관리:** people with active 감사 열람 are marked "감사 열람 중", and the texts now mention 감사 열람.
- **New pages:** SCR-59 and SCR-61..65, each with the standard skeleton, gray info box, header comment, access gate and a minimal render.

All edited and new JS files pass node --check. Nothing was run in a browser.

gaps_filled: What a hold blocks: all new drafts (including 보완 후 재기안), approving remaining steps (APPROVE on every step except SXP, REGISTER), 유예 요청 and 유예 확인. A termination still in approval is also frozen, because a refund could go to the held party.
The hold reason is shown to everyone who can see the contract [가정]. The 보류 걸기 dialog tells COMPLIANCE not to write investigation details or the reporter's name.
Risk grade rule [가정]: any problem result means 높음; otherwise 간접 is 보통, and 국가와 지자체 or 조달 only is 낮음. The grade is stored with each check record and recalculated live in the dialog.
Problem values: 제재 명단 해당 있음, 부정적 보도 있음, 실제 소유자 문제 있음 or 확인 못 함, 공직자 관련 있음. 실제 소유자 also has the option 해당 없음(국가와 지자체).

The checker picks the 확인 상태 (문제 없음 or 문제 있음) separately from the item results. If a result shows a problem but they choose 문제 없음, the help text says the note must explain why; this is not enforced. The risk grade still comes out 높음.
